name: Silicon Valley Mariachi Festival
imageAlt: Silicon Valley Mariachi Festival website shown on a desktop display
body: We’ve had the honor of designing and developing the Silicon Valley Mariachi Festival website two years in a row. Their team continues to choose us because of our fast, real-time collaboration style — working side-by-side via screenshare to bring ideas to life instantly.
From event details to ticket integration and vibrant visuals, we helped create a site that captures the energy of the festival while making it easy for attendees to engage, explore, and get involved.
result: Return client who sold 2,000 tickets for the 2024 festival, and has now tripled in sales for 2025 with the new website.
